title: TimeLabels
description: Short, deterministic date/time labels for Swift UIs — 'In 2h', '5mins ago', '3:30 PM', 'Tomorrow'.
why: Turn raw Dates into the short strings a UI needs without duplicating DateFormatter setup across screens. Thread-safe, deterministic output, plus Date extensions and a self-updating SwiftUI TimeLabelText.
stack: Swift 6.0+, SwiftUI — iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS
